abstract: In recent decades, agriculture has become increasingly concentrated through horizontal mergers and acquisitions via corporate entities, and policy makers are concerned this will be exacerbated by the aging population of farm operators. To reduce market concentration in agriculture, many states have enacted policies to entice new prospective entrepreneurs into farming. Among these are tax credits for existing farm owners who lease or sell farmland to “beginning farmers.” These subsidies aim to compensate the lessor for the additional risk associated with leasing land to a new farming enterprise. This paper investigates the effect of Iowa's Beginning Farmer Tax Credit program on land leased to farmers, farm operators' average age, and various metrics of non‐corporate farm operations. Our point estimates suggest very small effects of the program on Iowa's prevailing farm trajectories with a budgetary cost of more than $100,000 per added independent farm.
abstract_zh: 近几十年来，农业通过企业实体的横向并购日益集中，政策制定者担忧农场经营者老龄化将加剧这一趋势。为降低农业市场集中度，许多州已出台政策吸引新的潜在创业者进入农业领域。其中一项措施是，对将农田租赁或出售给“初创农民”的现有农场主给予税收抵免。这些补贴旨在补偿出租方因将土地租赁给新农业企业而承担的额外风险。本文研究了爱荷华州“初创农民税收抵免计划”对租赁给农民的土地、农场经营者的平均年龄以及非公司制农场运营各项指标的影响。我们的点估计显示，该计划对爱荷华州现行农业发展趋势的影响甚微，而每增加一个独立农场所需的预算成本超过10万美元。
title: Do Tax Incentives for Farmland Leases Increase Farm Supply? Evidence From Iowa's Beginning Farmer Tax Credit
title_zh: 农业用地租赁税收优惠是否增加了农业供给？来自爱荷华州初创农民税收抵免的证据

abstract: In this paper, we investigate alpha testing for high‐dimensional linear factor pricing models. We propose a spatial‐sign‐based max‐type test to detect sparse alternatives. Additionally, the asymptotic independence between this test and the existing spatial‐sign‐based sum‐type test is established. Based on this result, we introduce a Cauchy combination test procedure that combines both the max‐type and sum‐type tests. Simulation studies and real data applications demonstrate that the proposed test procedure is robust to heavy‐tailed distributions and powerful against alternatives with different sparsity levels.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了高维线性因子定价模型中的alpha检验。我们提出了一种基于空间符号的max型检验，用于检测稀疏备择假设。此外，本文建立了该检验与现有基于空间符号的sum型检验之间的渐近独立性。基于这一结果，我们引入了一种Cauchy组合检验方法，将max型检验和sum型检验相结合。模拟研究和实际数据应用表明，所提出的检验方法对重尾分布具有稳健性，并且对不同稀疏程度的备择假设具有较高的检验功效。
journal: Oxford Bulletin of Economics and Statistics
title: Robust High Dimensional Alpha Test for Linear Factor Pricing Model
title_zh: 线性因子定价模型的稳健高维Alpha检验

abstract: From 2006 until 2020, the probability of selling a house in the U.S. declined sharply after listing for 2 weeks. Moreover, sales within the first 2 weeks of listing (“quick sales”) and sales happening afterward (“slow sales”) behaved differently over the housing cycle. The probability and associated price of a quick sale recovered from the slump sooner, faster, and more prominently than a slow sale. This paper demonstrates that a calibrated stock-flow matching model not only generates quantitatively consistent sales, prices, listings, and time on the market but also captures distinctions between fast and slow sales over the housing cycle.
abstract_zh: 从2006年至2020年，美国房屋挂牌两周后售出的概率急剧下降。此外，挂牌后两周内售出（“快速销售”）与之后售出（“慢速销售”）在房地产周期中的表现存在差异。快速销售的概率及其相关价格从低谷中恢复得更早、更快且更为显著，相比之下慢速销售则不然。本文证明，一个校准的存量-流量匹配模型不仅能在数量上生成一致的销售量、价格、挂牌量及市场停留时间，还能捕捉住房周期中快速与慢速销售之间的差异。
title: The Short and the Long of It: Stock‐Flow Matching in the US Housing Market
title_zh: 长短之辨：美国住房市场中的存量-流量匹配

abstract: We investigate how exposure to extreme temperature affects smallholder commercialization. We examine a range of outcomes that indicate the degree of commercialization, including market participation, sales quantity, commercialization index, and sales revenue, which serves as an indicator of monetary benefit. Recognizing the non-separability between production and commercialization, we also examine how extreme temperature directly affects agricultural production. To address these questions, we develop a simple and straightforward theoretical framework that links temperature events to production and market dynamics. From this framework, we derive a set of hypotheses which we proceed to test empirically. Our empirical strategy leverages a comprehensive three-wave panel dataset, which we integrate with earth observation data on temperature extremes. We find that extreme temperatures lead to production losses. We also observe significant declines in market participation among smallholder farmers which could be explained by production shortfalls. This reduction is evident at both the extensive margin (likelihood of participating in markets) and the intensive margin (sales quantity). Furthermore, we observe that when farmers face extreme temperatures, the proportion of harvested crops they sell and the resulting revenue from these also decrease. Causal mediation analysis further confirms that production losses due to extreme temperatures explains the reduction in market outcomes. Overall, these findings highlight the broader economic burden that extreme weather events continue to impose on smallholder households.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了极端温度暴露如何影响小农户的商业化程度。我们考察了一系列反映商业化程度的指标，包括市场参与、销售量、商业化指数以及作为货币收益指标的销售收入。鉴于生产与商业化之间的不可分割性，我们还探讨了极端温度如何直接影响农业生产。为解答这些问题，我们构建了一个简洁明了的理论框架，将温度事件与生产和市场动态联系起来。基于此框架，我们推导出一系列假设，并随后进行实证检验。我们的实证策略利用了一个包含三轮调查的面板数据集，并将其与关于极端温度的地球观测数据相结合。我们发现极端温度导致生产损失。同时，我们观察到小农户的市场参与显著下降，这可由生产短缺来解释。这种减少在广度边际（参与市场的可能性）和强度边际（销售量）上均有所体现。此外，我们还发现，当农户面临极端温度时，其收获作物中出售的比例以及由此产生的收入也相应减少。因果中介分析进一步证实，极端温度导致的生产损失解释了市场结果的下降。总体而言，这些发现凸显了极端天气事件对小农户家庭持续施加的更广泛经济负担。
title: Extreme heat and markets: Theoretical and empirical evidence from Nigeria
title_zh: 极端高温与市场：来自尼日利亚的理论与实证证据

abstract: Soil tests provide information that can help farmers optimize their inputs. This can reduce costs, increase yields and profits, and contribute to sustainable soil health. Yet soil tests are rarely used by small-scale farmers and are typically not offered by extension workers. Instead, high hopes are pinned on a market-based dissemination. In this study, we elicit small-scale farmers’ willingness-to-pay (WTP) for rapid, low-cost soil tests using incentive-compatible auctions. Additionally, we test whether randomized participation in a sustainable soil management training can increase farmers’ WTP. Furthermore, we elicit WTP in an alternative setting by measuring the willingness to contribute to the costs of a soil test kit when entire farmer groups are offered kits containing 50 tests. The average WTP for soil tests amounts to 39% of the market price and is not statistically different if soil tests are offered to groups where free riding is possible. Participants who were exposed to prior training do not exhibit a higher WTP per test. Data collected five months after the WTP experiment indicate an association between soil testing and reduced use of inorganic fertilizers—particularly nitrogen—as well as more sustainable input management in the context characterized by prevalent overuse. Our results can guide the integration of subsidized soil tests into extension programs.
abstract_zh: 土壤测试能提供有助于农户优化投入品的信息，从而降低成本、提高产量和利润，并促进土壤健康的可持续发展。然而，小农户很少使用土壤测试，推广人员通常也不提供此项服务。相反，人们寄厚望于基于市场的推广方式。本研究通过激励相容的拍卖方式，测度小农户对快速、低成本土壤测试的支付意愿（WTP）。此外，我们检验了随机参与可持续土壤管理培训是否能提高农户的支付意愿。进一步地，我们在另一种情境下测度支付意愿，即当整个农户群体获得包含50次测试的土壤测试套件时，衡量其为该套件成本分担的意愿。结果显示，土壤测试的平均支付意愿为市场价格的39%，且在允许搭便车行为的群体情境下，支付意愿在统计上无显著差异。接受过先前培训的参与者并未表现出更高的单次测试支付意愿。在支付意愿实验五个月后收集的数据表明，土壤测试与无机肥料（尤其是氮肥）使用减少之间存在关联，并在普遍存在过度使用的背景下，促进了更可持续的投入品管理。我们的研究结果可为将补贴性土壤测试纳入推广计划提供指导。
journal: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
source_issue: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management, Volume 138
title: Smallholders’ willingness to pay for information: A comparison of individual purchase decisions with contributions to a club good. Evidence from Indonesian rice farmers
title_zh: 小农户对信息的支付意愿：个体购买决策与俱乐部物品贡献的比较——来自印度尼西亚稻农的证据

abstract: Recent scientometric evidence published in this journal (Mitra, S., Palmer, M, Vuong, V. (2020). Development and Interdisciplinary: A citation analysis. World Development, 135, 105076; hereafter MPV) suggests that development is not an interdisciplinary field as it predominantly references mainstream economics and shows limited interaction with other disciplines. This article validates the study of MPV and extends it in several ways. First, it introduces an alternative method for identifying the economics background of development scholars by matching bibliometric data with the Research Papers in Economics (RePEc) author database. Second, it applies an extensive multi-level citation analysis, based on all journal references available from the Web of Science database. A replication of the cited-reference analysis of 29,619 articles across 17 development journals confirms MPV’s findings: the lack of interdisciplinarity in development is driven primarily by research by authors with an economics background. However, this study estimates a much larger share of such research than MPV. Third, a regression analysis reveals that works authored by economists receive significantly more citations. Fourth, a comparative analysis of author affiliations shows that articles with an economics background are predominantly associated with renowned (international) policy institutions, particularly the World Bank. Fifth, a discursive analysis of article abstracts based on structural topic modeling identifies research topics associated with (non-)economists, and thus, higher or lower levels of interdisciplinarity. Overall, the findings highlight several policy implications as development research conducted by economists differs significantly across multiple dimensions, with these differences being even more pronounced among ‘top-five’ economists.
abstract_zh: 本刊近期发表的一篇科学计量学证据（Mitra, S., Palmer, M, Vuong, V. (2020). Development and Interdisciplinarity: A citation analysis. World Development, 135, 105076；以下简称MPV）表明，发展研究并非一个跨学科领域，因为它主要引用主流经济学文献，与其他学科的互动有限。本文验证了MPV的研究，并在多个方面进行了拓展。首先，本文引入了一种替代方法，通过将文献计量数据与经济学研究论文（RePEc）作者数据库进行匹配，来识别发展学者的经济学背景。其次，本文基于Web of Science数据库中所有期刊参考文献，进行了广泛的多层次引文分析。对17种发展期刊中29,619篇文章的引文参考文献分析进行复制，证实了MPV的发现：发展研究中跨学科性的缺乏主要由具有经济学背景的作者的研究所驱动。然而，本研究估计此类研究所占比例远高于MPV的估计。第三，回归分析显示，经济学家撰写的著作获得的引用显著更多。第四，对作者所属机构的比较分析表明，具有经济学背景的文章主要与国际知名（国际）政策机构相关，尤其是世界银行。第五，基于结构主题模型对文章摘要进行的话语分析，识别了与（非）经济学家相关的研究主题，从而反映了跨学科性的高低程度。总体而言，研究结果凸显了若干政策启示，因为经济学家开展的发展研究在多个维度上存在显著差异，且这些差异在“五大”经济学家中更为突出。
title: Development and interdisciplinarity: additional insights on the ‘economics silo’
title_zh: 发展与跨学科性：关于“经济学孤岛”的补充见解

abstract: Gentzkow and Kamenica (2016) show that competition among senders benefits receivers if and only if the information environment is Blackwell-connected. This paper shows that introducing receivers’ limited attention and heterogeneous beliefs can overturn this result. Even in a Blackwell-connected information environment, information revelation may be lower under duopoly than under monopoly. Indeed, limited attention may incentivize receivers to sort into the audiences of like-minded senders. In turn, this adverse sorting can make it optimal for senders to reveal less information.
abstract_zh: Gentzkow和Kamenica（2016）的研究表明，当且仅当信息环境是Blackwell连通的时，发送者之间的竞争对接收者有利。本文证明，引入接收者的有限注意力和异质性信念可以颠覆这一结论。即使在Blackwell连通的信息环境中，双头垄断下的信息揭示程度也可能低于垄断情形。实际上，有限注意力可能激励接收者选择加入与自己观点相似的发送者受众群体。反过来，这种不利的分群可能使发送者最优选择揭示更少的信息。
title: Competition in persuasion in the attention economy
title_zh: 注意力经济中的说服竞争

abstract: This note studies conditional forecasting under conditions on annual growth rates when variables enter a (possibly structural) vector autoregressive (VAR) model in logarithms or logarithmic first differences. Imposing conditions on the annual growth rate of, for example, quarterly real GDP modeled in logarithms is challenging because annual growth rates are nonlinear functions of the log variables. We derive a linear approximation that makes annual growth-rate conditions compatible with standard conditional forecasting methods and complement it with a damped iterative correction that enforces the nonlinear annual-growth restriction up to numerical tolerance. We provide MATLAB companion code 2 that also accepts other types of conditions: (1) conditions on the path of variables entering the VAR, (2) conditions on the path of structural shocks, and (3) conditions on sums of successive variable observations.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了在变量以对数或对数一阶差分形式进入（可能为结构性的）向量自回归（VAR）模型时，对年度增长率施加条件进行条件预测的问题。例如，当季度实际GDP以对数形式建模时，对其年度增长率施加条件颇具挑战性，因为年度增长率是对数变量的非线性函数。我们推导出一种线性近似方法，使年度增长率条件能与标准条件预测方法兼容，并辅以阻尼迭代修正，以确保非线性年度增长约束在数值容差范围内得到满足。我们提供了MATLAB配套代码，该代码还支持其他类型的条件：（1）对进入VAR的变量路径施加条件，（2）对结构性冲击路径施加条件，以及（3）对连续变量观测值之和施加条件。
title: Forecasting with log-linear (S)VAR models: Incorporating annual growth rate conditions
title_zh: 使用对数线性(S)VAR模型进行预测：纳入年度增长率条件

abstract: This study investigates recruitment bias in the academic job market. We examine the link between statistical significance and placement outcomes for 200 empirical job market papers from 2018-2021. Marginally significant results are associated with higher academic placement likelihoods , suggesting a preference for statistical significance. This bias may incentivize questionable research practices. The COVID-19 pandemic intensified these dynamics, with marginal significance gaining greater weight in hiring decisions during competitive periods. Evidence of publication bias indicates recruiters may use statistical significance to predict future publications, shaping hiring decisions. These findings highlight systemic challenges to research integrity in economics.
abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了学术就业市场中的招聘偏见。我们分析了2018至2021年间200篇实证求职论文，考察统计显著性与就业结果之间的关联。边缘显著的结果与更高的学术职位获得可能性相关，表明存在对统计显著性的偏好。这种偏见可能助长可疑的研究实践。COVID-19疫情加剧了这一动态，在竞争激烈时期，边缘显著性在招聘决策中权重增加。出版偏见的证据表明，招聘者可能利用统计显著性预测未来发表情况，从而影响招聘决策。这些发现凸显了经济学研究诚信面临的系统性挑战。
title: Job market stars: Statistical significance and academic hiring in economics
title_zh: 就业市场明星：经济学中的统计显著性与学术招聘

abstract: We establish a mean-field stochastic framework for analyzing institutional lock-in driven by asymmetric belief updating. A continuum of agents update confidence levels s_tthrough success/failure experiences, with update functions F_S,F_Fexhibiting negativity bias: failures impact beliefs more strongly than successes of equal magnitude. Aggregate confidence I_tinfluences the success probability \pi(I_t), creating feedback between individual psychology and collective outcomes. We prove existence of stationary equilibria via Schauder’s fixed-point theorem on the space of probability measures \mathcal{P}\left(\left[0,1\right]\right), establishing compactness through Prokhorov’s theorem. Stability is characterized via spectral analysis of Fréchet derivatives in the bounded-Lipschitz metric, with operator decomposition into push-forward L_{\mu^\ast} and rank-one feedback R_{\mu^\ast} components. Under negativity bias and positive feedback, we establish multiplicity: generically three equilibria (low, middle, high) with stable-unstable-stable pattern. For escape dynamics from stable equilibria, we establish a large deviation principle on Skorokhod space D\left([0,\infty\right),\mathcal{P}\left(\left[0,1\right]\right)) with rate function determined by a quasi-potential computed via action functional minimization. Expected escape times scale as exp\left(N\cdot V\right) where N is population size and V is the quasi-potential, confirming exponential rarity: for calibrated parameters with N={10}^6 agents, escape times exceed {10}^{63,900} periods. We derive comparative statics for reform policy through optimal control: value function concavity implies optimal sequencing places high-success-probability reforms first. Material investments M and psychological interventions P exhibit strategic complementarity (\partial^2I^\ast/\partial M\partial P>0), verified through implicit function theorem analysis. Numerical verification with {10}^6 Monte Carlo simulations confirms all theoretical predictions, with robustness checks across alternative functional specifications. The framework provides a rigorous foundation for understanding institutional persistence as emerging from collective psychological dynamics rather than material coordination failures, with implications for development economics, political economy, and organizational change.
abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个平均场随机框架，用以分析由不对称信念更新所驱动的制度锁定现象。在此框架中，一个连续统的代理人通过成功/失败经历更新其信心水平s_t，更新函数F_S,F_F展现出负面偏差：同等强度的失败对信念的影响大于成功。总体信心I_t影响成功概率\pi(I_t)，从而在个体心理与集体结果之间形成反馈机制。我们通过Schauder不动点定理在概率测度空间\mathcal{P}\left(\left[0,1\right]\right)上证明了平稳均衡的存在性，并利用Prokhorov定理确立了紧致性。稳定性通过有界-Lipschitz度量下Fréchet导数的谱分析来刻画，其中算子分解为前推L_{\mu^\ast}与秩一反馈R_{\mu^\ast}两部分。在负面偏差与正反馈条件下，我们确立了多重性：一般存在三个均衡（低、中、高），呈现稳定-不稳定-稳定的模式。对于从稳定均衡的逃逸动态，我们在Skorokhod空间D\left([0,\infty\right),\mathcal{P}\left(\left[0,1\right]\right))上建立了大偏差原理，其速率函数由通过作用泛函最小化计算的准势决定。预期逃逸时间按exp\left(N\cdot V\right)缩放，其中N为总体规模，V为准势，从而确认了指数量级的稀有性：对于校准参数，当N={10}^6个代理人时，逃逸时间超过{10}^{63,900}个时期。我们通过最优控制推导了改革政策的比较静态分析：价值函数的凹性意味着最优排序应将高成功概率的改革置于首位。物质投资M与心理干预P表现出策略互补性（\partial^2I^\ast/\partial M\partial P>0），这一结论通过隐函数定理分析得到验证。基于{10}^6次蒙特卡洛模拟的数值验证确认了所有理论预测，并在不同函数设定下进行了稳健性检验。该框架为理解制度持续性源于集体心理动态而非物质协调失败提供了严谨基础，对发展经济学、政治经济学与组织变革具有启示意义。
title: Psychological lock-in and institutional persistence: A mean-field model of confidence dynamics
title_zh: 心理锁定与制度持续性：信心动力学的平均场模型

abstract: This paper examines the effects of ex ante market structure on spectrum auctions and their impact on mobile market outcomes. We review the relevant theory and provide a simple analytic framework suggesting that larger incumbents acquire more spectrum in auctions to disadvantage smaller competitors. Using novel data on European 4G spectrum auctions, we present suggestive evidence of this effect for low-band ( < 1GHz) auctions. Exploiting idiosyncratic differences in auction timing across countries, we show that HHIs, and potentially prices, increase following low-band auctions, particularly in markets where incumbent operators had relatively high pre-auction market shares. These changes are not accompanied by improvements in coverage or increased investment. Operator-level regressions show that these effects are driven by incumbent operator behaviour.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了事前市场结构对频谱拍卖的影响及其对移动市场结果的作用。我们回顾了相关理论，并提供了一个简洁的分析框架，表明规模较大的在位运营商在拍卖中获取更多频谱，以削弱较小竞争对手的地位。利用欧洲4G频谱拍卖的新数据，我们为低频段（<1GHz）拍卖中的这一效应提供了提示性证据。利用各国拍卖时间上的特有差异，我们显示，在低频段拍卖后，赫芬达尔指数（HHIs）以及潜在的价格会上升，尤其是在拍卖前在位运营商市场份额相对较高的市场中。这些变化并未伴随覆盖范围的改善或投资的增加。运营商层面的回归分析表明，这些效应主要由在位运营商的行为驱动。
source_issue: International Journal of Industrial Organization, Volume 106
title: Interaction of spectrum auctions and mobile market competition: Review of theory and evidence from European 4G auctions
title_zh: 频谱拍卖与移动市场竞争的互动：理论与欧洲4G拍卖证据综述
